overlap_checks.check: Abandoned checkout, today: SMS flow vs email flow on Started Checkout

opt_in_kit.keyword: BEANS (text it to the toll-free number once verified)

two_step_form.step_2: mobile number, with the disclosure below the field

opt_in_kit.form_disclosure: By entering your number, you agree to receive recurring automated marketing texts from Brindlemoss Coffee (up to 6 msgs/mo) at this number. Consent is not a condition of purchase. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply HELP for help, STOP to cancel. See our Terms and Privacy Policy.
opt_in_kit.confirmation_text: Brindlemoss Coffee: Thanks for joining! Recurring automated marketing texts, up to 6 msgs/mo. Consent not required to buy. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply HELP for help, STOP to cancel. Reply Y to confirm.
opt_in_kit.double_opt_in: The confirmation text asks for 'Reply Y to confirm' because 74.2% of US SMS subscribers are single opt-in.
opt_in_kit.whatsapp_opt_in: A separate checkbox at Mexico checkout: 'Quiero recibir avisos de pedidos y ofertas de Brindlemoss Coffee por WhatsApp.'

compliance_pass.detail: Toll-free verification is pending. Send nothing until it is approved, and make the sample messages in the request match the texts below.

The checkout wording is missing: recurring automated marketing, consent not a condition of purchase, Msg & data rates may apply, HELP and STOP, terms and privacy links. It promises up to 4 msgs/mo but the plan can send up to 6. Use the new wording in the opt-in kit.

'Flash sale 24h' went out at 21:15 Eastern (18:15 Pacific) on 2026-10-07. Schedule campaigns at 13:00 Eastern or in recipient local time, and turn on quiet hours so flow texts triggered at night wait for morning.

140 Canadian profiles get texts: confirm with counsel that the store keeps each consent record, that every text names the business and a contact, and that the unsubscribe works for 60 days and is processed within 10 business days.
Confirm the WhatsApp opt-in wording and Mexico's consent rules with counsel before the first template.
Marketing texts go only to SMS-consented US and Canada profiles (3,260 in Klaviyo; 3,120 used for sizing, the smaller source per country); Mexico gets WhatsApp only after a WhatsApp opt-in.
Every message starts with the brand name.
Every marketing text carries the STOP line; HELP and STOP replies are written.
Klaviyo's own short links, no public shortener.
Coffee is not a restricted topic.
Shipping is utility with no promotion; abandoned checkout, back in stock, win-back, campaign are marketing.
WhatsApp is planned for Mexico only; US marketing stays on SMS while Meta's pause on marketing templates to US numbers holds.
Every WhatsApp message is a template, so none depends on the 24-hour window.

launch_order: Finish toll-free verification; send nothing before approval.
Replace the checkout disclosure with the new wording and add the two-step form and the BEANS keyword.
Merge the two abandoned checkout flows (text at 30 minutes, email at 2 hours, one exit on order) and fix the curly apostrophe.
Turn on quiet hours and move campaigns to 13:00 Eastern or recipient local time.
Add the back in stock and win-back texts, then the shipping text.
Hold SMS campaigns at 2 a month; review unsubscribes after 90 days.
Mexico: add the WhatsApp opt-in, get the 5 templates approved, then start with shipping updates.
go_deeper: email-sequence-builder for the emails next to these texts, klaviyo-flow-auditor for the email flows, copywriting for the pages the links go to (if installed).
